tools.name: get_descriptor
tools.description: Return the TrustAI Verification MCP self-description: operator, what the server verifies, the public tools, the boundary it never crosses (it never adjudicates), and links to the public surfaces.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Return the structural checks this server performs on legal-AI output, and — explicitly — what it never claims. Information, not legal advice.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Return server health: process uptime and a deterministic engine self-check (the structural detectors run on a fixed sample and return the expected flag counts). Local-only; no database on the path.

tools.name: review_legal_text
tools.description: Independently review legal text produced by ANY AI vendor for the structural red-flags behind fabrication risk: (1) orphan quotations — a quoted span with no citation in its sentence, the citation sentence after it, or its footnote; (2) uncited propositions — law stated as established (a holding cue

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "review_legal_text" is 1317 chars, far longer than this server's median (196). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "review_legal_text" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
